title: La gotera
goal: Report a leak and get it fixed before the rains
culture: The rains start in May and after that it is every afternoon, so a drip in March is a small favour and a drip in June is an emergency for everybody at once. The deadline is the useful part of the report.

beats.good: Una gotera is a drip through the roof and every house here has had one. Naming it is the whole report.
Cuarto again — the same word as your first night in the hostel. Arriba here means up there, not west: context does that work.
Which is the important half of the report, because in May it will be raining every afternoon and so will the roof.

beats.es: Ah, ya. Le digo a mi hijo que suba a verlo.
beats.objective: Ask for it before the rains
beats.say: ¿Lo puede ver antes de las lluvias?
beats.en: Could he look at it before the rains?
ok: lo puede ver antes de las lluvias
beats.good: Ask for the timing as well as the fix. Antes de las lluvias is a real deadline here and everybody understands exactly how much time it means.
